title: The studio
caption: Riding With The King open in the standalone app: the mix, the lead and rhythm charts drawn as tablature (chords framed and named, sustains, techniques), the lyrics syllable by syllable, sections and the beat grid on one timeline.

title: Chart editing
caption: A note selected: fret, string, sustain, bend, slide and every technique in the inspector (or from the keyboard: type the fret, H P B S V...). Draw, move, stretch, erase, quantize, copy and paste, with undo.

title: Song details and charts
caption: Title, artist, album, sorting, volumes and album art (any image, stored as the game's DDS); add a lead, rhythm, bass or combo chart in any tuning.

title: Lyrics, synced to the recording
caption: Timed lyrics (LRCLIB, a .lrc file or pasted) become Rocksmith syllables; auto-sync lays them over where the recording sings (here 1.6 s off, moved back); then tap-sync, stretch or drag any syllable.

title: Instrument stems
caption: Vocals, guitar, bass, drums and the rest, separated using the song's own charts (a harmonic comb at every charted note) and lyrics; mute, solo and mix them, download each as WAV or keep them next to the song. Here: the vocals muted to sing along.

title: Beats and tempo
caption: The beat grid the notes snap to and the game counts bars by: detected from the audio, or a tempo from any beat on; drag a beat, set bar starts, x2 / /2, shift the whole chart, metronome on playback.

title: A new song from an audio file
caption: Drop an mp3, ogg, wav, flac or m4a (or a Wwise .wem): the details come from the file name, the beat grid from the audio, and empty lead / rhythm / bass charts are ready to draw in.

title: Save for PC or Mac, checked
caption: The package is built in the browser (unchanged files byte for byte, edited charts recompiled), saved into the library and read back with RockShiny's own parsers: every chart's XML and SNG must agree.

title: A page of RockShiny
caption: The same module plugged into the RockShiny app: Home | Instrument | Karaoke | Creator. A song saved here opens at once in the Instrument or Karaoke mode (Play it / Sing it).

title: One offline HTML file
caption: RockShinyCreator.html: the whole studio in one file that opens from disk with no server and no network. .psarc files are read, decoded (Wwise audio included), edited and written in the page.

title: Difficulty levels, kept and edited
caption: Get Lucky's own difficulty levels, kept when the song is edited. The lead at level 1 of 0-7 (what a beginner plays), with the notes of the full chart it leaves out as dashed ghosts; the bonus lead below plays the full chart. Pick a level, edit it like any chart, add or remove a level for one part or everywhere; PgUp / PgDn step through the levels.

title: Easier levels, created automatically
caption: Sultans of Swing has no levels: 'Create easier levels' makes them from the full chart, as chart authors do: the strongest beats first, chords on fewer strings at easy levels, more levels for busy parts. Here the rhythm part at level 2, the rest of the full chart as dashed ghosts. Saved, RockShiny's difficulty slider uses the levels.

title: Help built in
caption: The Help dialog (the ? button, the ? key, or Help in the sidebar): start here, what the Creator can do, what it can't do (no transcription, stems and automatic levels are helpers, not studio-grade...), how difficulty levels work, and every shortcut.

title: A guided tour
caption: Take the tour: a spotlight moves over each part of the studio and of its page (open, the library, save) with a card that explains it; arrow keys to step, Esc to leave. Here: the difficulty levels.
